executiveSummary: A powerful 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia with high urban impact; reporting varies but at least 111-265 fatalities have been cited, hundreds missing, and >25,800 families affected. View Article Fast-moving wildfires around British Columbia's Okanagan region forced 20,000+ evacuations, destroyed homes, and caused at least one death amid continuing displacement. Source Severe storms and flash flooding in the U.S. Midwest caused widespread damage, multiple deaths, power outages for hundreds of thousands, and ongoing rescues. Supporting Report Monsoon flooding in India's Assam displaced 700,000+ people, placed ~300,000 in relief camps, and raised the death toll to 100 with rivers above danger levels. View Article Typhoon conditions triggered mass relocations (300,000+) in China, significant flight cancellations, and landslide risks across China, Taiwan, and the Philippines. Security Advisory

outlook72h: Western Colombia Earthquake High likelihood of continued aftershocks, complex SAR, and evolving casualty figures. Expect ongoing access and debris management constraints in dense urban areas. British Columbia Wildfires Continued evacuation operations, re-entry restrictions, and variable containment; anticipate air quality impacts and priority protection of critical infrastructure. U.S. Midwest Severe Weather Residual flooding and scattered severe storms may persist; utility restoration and debris clearance will remain a focus in impacted counties. Assam Flooding River levels may remain elevated; relief camps and WASH services require surge support as waters recede unevenly. Typhoon-Affected Areas Continued landslide and flash-flood potential; transport disruptions and shelter demand likely where relocations are active. Urban-Interface Fires (Spokane area) Perimeter control, re-population planning, and critical services restoration; monitor wind shifts and new ignitions.
